text: Rotational therapy may be used to minimise long-term toxicity by using each treatment for 1 to 2 years; methotrexate, acitretin, and UV therapy have been used in this way.6 However, ciclosporin should not follow PUVA therapy in this way because of an increased risk of cutane- ous squamous cell carcinoma.5 There is limited experience with the use of newer immunomodulating drugs in these regimens.6 1.
